QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Hiring a Hairstylist
QuestInfo.0: You agree to find a top hairstylist for the debut of Jackpot Entertainment's new group. Go find #bPatricia Paneer#k at the #r6F Hair Salon#k.
QuestInfo.1: #t4036025:# items are required to create the perfect hairstyle. Gather #b15#k #b#i4036025:# #t4036025:##k items, then take them to #bPatricia Paneer#k. #r#o4310013##k and #r#o4310014##k in the area should have them.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #b15#k #b#i4036025:# #t4036025:##k items to Patricia Paneer and hired her for the broadcast. Return to Blake's office.

0.msg: Hi there. I'm with Jackpot Entertainment. You may have seen on television that our new musical group is going to perform on Kerning City Superstars. We still need someone to do the girls' hair. According to these Yap reviews, you're the person to see!

1.msg: Kerning City Superstars?! Say no more! This'll be spectacular publicity for my salon!

2.msg: But what am I going to do? I'm all out of #b#i4036025:# #t4036025:##k items, and at my salon there can be no substitute!

3.msg: How am I, Patricia Paneer, harbinger of hairstyle excellence, to make my art without them?

4.msg: I know! You can get some for me!

yes.0: And there are five members in your group? Very well, #b15#k #b#i4036025:# #t4036025:##k items should suffice. Perhaps you can acquire some from those troublesome #r#o4310013##k and \r\n#r#o4310014##k monsters. I mean, really! Whoever heard of a monster-friendly mall?!

no.0: Oh, my. I can't do anything without them.

1.0: Oh, my! You brought #b15#k #b#i4036025:# #t4036025:##k items! Yes, yes! I can work absolute WONDERS with these!

yes.0: I'll come up with a fresh new look for Jackpot Entertainment's group before their debut broadcast. You won't be disappointed!
yes.1: ...Oh, my! Must they play their guitar so loudly?! You'd think security would do something about that... Perhaps there's some kind of event going on?
